commands:
cat > jobs/board_pack_export.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Writes monthly revenue to a CSV for the board pack every night. Priya.
set -euo pipefail
PGPASSFILE="$HOME/exports/board_pack.pgpass" psql -X -q -w -U reporting --csv -c "SELECT month, region, revenue, orders FROM reporting.monthly_revenue ORDER BY month, region" -o "$HOME/exports/board_pack_revenue.csv"
EOF
chmod +x jobs/board_pack_export.sh
git add jobs/board_pack_export.sh etc/crontab && git -c user.name='Priya Nair' -c user.email=priya@northwind.example commit -q -m 'Nightly board pack export' && git log --oneline -1
